offer.text: Skeletons have been rattling around the old ruins. Put down 6 of them and the roads will be safer.

accept.text: Aim for the ribs. Bring me back nothing but quiet.

decline.text: Then keep your shield up out there.

in_progress.text: How many skeletons are left clattering about?

ready.text: Six down? The night is a little less dangerous for it.

complete.text: Steel and nerve — you've both. Well earned.
